name: Tutorial: your first shoot, in command of the Osa 21
description: The first playable test, with the guide (data/tutorials/first_shoot.json) on the screen. Battery 21's Osa stands cold in its position south-west of the Kesmark bridges, the command post, the reload vehicle and the fuel truck beside it. A practice drone flies in slowly from the north-west, and a second one from the south-west later. Nobody gives the crew orders but you: the guide shows you the camera views (F1 to F11), takes you into the commander's seat, and walks you through К бою, the search, taking the target, preparing and permitting the launch, and watching the missile fly. Fictional; placeholder target numbers.
notes: Fictional. Positions as in kesmark_range_test.json (battery 21 at places_pannonia bty21_v1, its support vehicles round it; heights on the map's ground). No other launchers, so the targets are the player's. No crew_commander: the crew waits for the player's orders (the commander's seat's crew menu, O). The drones' numbers are PLACEHOLDERS: slow and steady so a first-time player has the time to learn the views and the orders (sim time can be sped up, Ctrl+Z). The first drone is in the sky from the start, far out, so the aircraft views (F5, F8) have something to show.
